title: claude-pr-automerge must re-check the PR's CURRENT head before arming (a hold declared after a queued run can be armed over)
note: [2026-10-14 weekly planning] OPERATOR-APPROVED 2026-10-14. Source: PI-20261007-CJT6J2S9-0001 -- MEASURED on PR #16984: run 37671365711 queued on head 6efa01a3 (landing: self) at 19:01:47Z, executed 19:49:10Z, and armed native auto-merge although the head had become ef82483b with landing: hold and no request file. Build: the request gate and the E63 landing gate read the PR's head at execution time (pull_request_read), refuse when the request file or the self declaration is gone from that head, and log the queued-vs-current sha pair. Test with the #16984 shape. Related cluster: AUTOMERGE-GAPS.
